title: Learning to Love dplR: Or Using R for Tree-Ring Analysis
description: A book about doing tree-ring analysis in R with the dplR package. It covers reading and checking ring-width data, detrending, chronology statistics and chronology building, regional curve and signal-free standardization, crossdating, time series methods, and tree-level and disturbance work, with an emphasis on what each method does and when it misleads. Two ITRDB collections run through the book. It grew out of dplR workshop notes.
